# Constants
```{r constants}
GENE_DIR <- here("Data_Hold", "Gene_Scores")        # written by Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd
CSV_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "Statistical_Tests")  # output CSVs
PLOT_DIR <- here("Statistical_Tests")               # output plots
for (d in c(CSV_DIR, PLOT_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

TOP_N <- 100

boxplot_width  <- 7.5
boxplot_height <- 5.25

# key    = short name used in output column names
# prefix = dataset prefix from the extraction Rmd
# label  = display name in plots and tables
DATASETS <- data.frame(
  key    = c("azimuth", "pbmcs", "pollen", "braindata", "liver", "lung",
             "crc", "intestines", "mouseheart", "pbmc12k"),
  prefix = c("Azimuth_MMC", "PBMCs", "Pollen", "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex",
             "TabulaMuris_Liver", "TabulaMuris_Lung",
             "Human_CRC", "Human_Intestines", "Mouse_Heart", "PBMC12K"),
  label  = c("Azimuth MMC", "PBMCs", "Pollen", "HPMC",
             "Tabula Muris Liver", "Tabula Muris Lung",
             "Human CRC", "Human Intestines", "Mouse Heart", "PBMC12K"),
  group  = c(rep("labeled", 6), rep("unlabeled", 4)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

LABELED   <- DATASETS$key[DATASETS$group == "labeled"]
UNLABELED <- DATASETS$key[DATASETS$group == "unlabeled"]
LABEL_OF  <- setNames(DATASETS$label, DATASETS$key)
```

# Load precomputed gene scores
```{r load-gene-scores}
gene_score_path <- function(prefix) {
  file.path(GENE_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_gene_scores.csv"))
}

# 0 means "dropped by PG filters / not scored by Seurat" -> NA
read_gene_scores <- function(prefix) {
  gs <- read.csv(gene_score_path(prefix), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  gs$GPS[gs$GPS == 0]                       <- NA
  gs$HVG_Dispersion[gs$HVG_Dispersion == 0] <- NA
  gs
}

# Named vector of non-NA scores, sorted descending
sorted_scores <- function(values, genes) {
  keep <- !is.na(values)
  sort(setNames(values[keep], genes[keep]), decreasing = TRUE)
}

# Everything this Rmd needs for one dataset
load_dataset <- function(prefix, n = TOP_N) {
  gs         <- read_gene_scores(prefix)
  pg_scores  <- sorted_scores(gs$GPS,            gs$Gene)
  hvg_scores <- sorted_scores(gs$HVG_Dispersion, gs$Gene)

  pg_genes  <- names(head(pg_scores,  n))
  hvg_genes <- names(head(hvg_scores, n))

  list(
    pg    = pg_genes,
    hvg   = hvg_genes,
    # Rank of each top PG within the full HVG ranking (NA if Seurat did not score it)
    ranks = data.frame(
      gene     = pg_genes,
      PPS_rank = seq_along(pg_genes),
      HVG_rank = match(pg_genes, names(hvg_scores))
    ),
    # log2(raw + 1) mean and variance for every gene
    stats = data.frame(
      mean_expression = gs$Mean_Log2Expr,
      variance        = gs$Var_Log2Expr,
      row.names       = gs$Gene
    )
  )
}

missing <- DATASETS$prefix[!file.exists(gene_score_path(DATASETS$prefix))]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing gene score files in ", GENE_DIR, " for: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nRun Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd first.")
}

data <- setNames(lapply(DATASETS$prefix, load_dataset), DATASETS$key)
```

# Helpers
```{r helpers}
# Save a plot as both TIFF and JPEG
save_plot_tif_jpg <- function(plot, file_stem, width =2000/300, height = 1800/300) {
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stem, ".tif"),
         plot = plot, dpi = 300,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stem, ".jpg"),
         plot = plot, dpi = 300,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# Kendall tau between PPS rank and HVG rank of the top PGs
run_kendall <- function(keys) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(keys, function(k) {
    r    <- data[[k]]$ranks
    test <- cor.test(r$PPS_rank, r$HVG_rank, method = "kendall")  # drops NA pairs
    data.frame(
      dataset_name = LABEL_OF[[k]],
      tau          = unname(test$estimate),
      pvalue       = test$p.value
    )
  }))
}

# Precomputed log2 mean expression & variance for a gene set
get_gene_stats <- function(genes, stats) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(stats))
  data.frame(gene = genes, stats[genes, , drop = FALSE])
}

# PG and HVG gene stats for a set of datasets, in boxplot format
build_boxplot_df <- function(keys) {
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(keys, function(k) {
    d   <- data[[k]]
    pg  <- get_gene_stats(d$pg,  d$stats); pg$dataset  <- LABEL_OF[[k]]; pg$Category  <- "Principal Genes"
    hvg <- get_gene_stats(d$hvg, d$stats); hvg$dataset <- LABEL_OF[[k]]; hvg$Category <- "HVGs"
    rbind(pg, hvg)
  }))
  df$Category <- factor(df$Category, levels = c("Principal Genes", "HVGs"))
  df
}

# Side-by-side top PG and top HVG lists
build_gene_lists <- function(keys) {
  cols <- list()
  for (k in keys) {
    cols[[paste0(k, "_PG")]]  <- data[[k]]$pg
    cols[[paste0(k, "_HVG")]] <- data[[k]]$hvg
  }
  as.data.frame(cols)
}

make_gene_set_boxplot <- function(df, y_var, show_legend = TRUE,
                                  y_label = c(mean_expression = "Mean log2 expression",
                                              variance        = "Variance of log2 expression")[[y_var]]) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Category, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = Category)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label, fill = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      breaks = c("Principal Genes", "HVGs"),
      values = c("Principal Genes" = "#1BB7D8", "HVGs" = "#E55B1E")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          strip.text  = element_text(size = 16)
)
}

# Mean + variance boxplots (to PLOT_DIR) and the stats CSV (to CSV_DIR) for one group of datasets
run_boxplots <- function(keys, plot_suffix, csv_name) {
  df <- build_boxplot_df(keys)

  mean_plot <- make_gene_set_boxplot(df, "mean_expression", show_legend = FALSE)
  print(mean_plot)
  save_plot_tif_jpg(mean_plot,
                    file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0("Log2v2Mean_Expression_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_", plot_suffix)),
                    width = boxplot_width, height = boxplot_height)

  var_plot <- make_gene_set_boxplot(df, "variance", show_legend = TRUE)
  print(var_plot)
  save_plot_tif_jpg(var_plot,
                    file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0("Log2v2Variance_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_", plot_suffix)),
                    width = boxplot_width, height = boxplot_height)

  df$gene <- NULL
  write.csv(df, file.path(CSV_DIR, csv_name))
  invisible(df)
}
```

# Labeled datasets

## Kendall correlation
```{r kendall-correlation}
kendall_results <- run_kendall(LABELED)
kendall_results
write.csv(kendall_results, file.path(CSV_DIR, "Kendall_Correlation.csv"))
```

## Expression and variance boxplots
```{r expression-boxplots, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 5.25}
expression_boxplot_df <- run_boxplots(LABELED, "bydataset",
                                      "log2_mean_expression_variance_all_datasets.csv")
```

## Top gene lists
```{r gene-lists}
gene_dataframes <- build_gene_lists(LABELED)
write.csv(gene_dataframes, file.path(CSV_DIR, "top100genes_all_datasets.csv"))
```
